case_note: Diameter 45 mm, AISI 316L polished steel, with removable wire loop strap attachments (patented). Winding crown personalized OP.
dial: Black with luminous Arabic numerals and markers. Seconds at 9 o'clock.
crystal: Sapphire, formed of corundum, 1.9 mm thick. Anti-reflective coating.
movement_note: Hand-wound mechanical, exclusive Panerai OP XI calibre, 16½ lignes, 17 jewels, Glucydur® Balance, 21,600 alternations/hour. Incabloc® anti-shock device. Swan’s neck regulator. Power reserve 56 hours. Côtes de Genève decoration on the bridges.
bracelet: PANERAI personalised leather strap and large-size polished steel buckle.
